_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of_decedent.label: Estate Of Decedent
estate_of_decedent.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

residence_and_date_of_death.label: Residence And Date Of Death
residence_and_date_of_death.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

name_of_claimant.label: Name Of Claimant
name_of_claimant.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

address_of_claimant.label: Address Of Claimant
address_of_claimant.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

amount_claimed.label: Amount Claimed
amount_claimed.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

basis_for_claim.label: Basis For Claim
basis_for_claim.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

date_claim_due.label: Date Claim Due
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

nature_of_uncertainty.label: Nature Of Uncertainty
nature_of_uncertainty.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

claimant_signature_date.label: Claimant Signature Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

attorney_for_claimant_name.label: Attorney For Claimant Name
attorney_for_claimant_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_for_claimant_address.label: Attorney For Claimant Address
attorney_for_claimant_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

decision_by_personal_representative.label: Decision By Personal Representative
decision_by_personal_representative.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

partial_allowance_amount.label: Partial Allowance Amount
partial_allowance_amount.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

notice_mailed_date.label: Notice Mailed Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

personal_representative_signature_date.label: Personal Representative Signature Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

attorney_for_personal_rep_name.label: Attorney For Personal Rep Name
attorney_for_personal_rep_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_for_personal_rep_address.label: Attorney For Personal Rep Address
attorney_for_personal_rep_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

attorney_for_personal_rep_bar_number.label: Attorney For Personal Rep Bar Number
